about_the_game:
From two of the most defining electronic music producers in the Swedish electronic music world, Joel Mull and Nima Khak, the Wave Defense: Trappist - Soundtrack brings you a fresh and unique music experience never heard before.

With decades of experience touring all over the world, including the Stockholm underground scene and being resident DJ at the Unit Club, in Germany, this soundtrack is hand crafted to perfection.

The soundtrack includes the full playlist from Wave Defense: Trappist, but also two additional mixes - blending the Wave Defense: Trappist music experience to a complete music experience.
